# founder voice and editorial policy

First-person, specific, independent, reflective and technical. No invented anecdotes, achievements or credentials.

Use strong hooks only when supported by real evidence. All claims must link to current source cards; do not invent public metrics, investor/creator testimonials or founder experiences. Write useful technical content, avoid generic AI filler.
title: founder VOICE.md editorial contract
author: Project owner contracts
relevance: Editorial constraints and provisional positioning only; not proof of product capabilities or personal achievements
permissionBasis: Owner authorized local Phase C implementation and reviewable plans
